fact: During the 2026 transition from the DGRK to two new provincial agencies, Kinshasa's taxes are paid through the irms-dgrk platform with notes de perception issued under the former DGRK header, with the new agencies fully effective from 1 January 2027.
title: Retour sur la matinée fiscale d'information et de présentation de deux nouvelles régies provinciales chargées de percevoir les impôts, droits, taxes et redevances de la ville de Kinshasa
